title: Russian air defenses down 43 Ukrainian drones during day
summary: Between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. Moscow time (5:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. GMT - TASS), on-duty air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 43 Ukrainian fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles over the Kursk, Belgorod, Oryol, Bryansk, and Rostov Regions, the Republic of Crimea, as well as over the Black Sea,
